rule: off-list floor first = Youden index between chunks aligned only with off-list passages and chunks aligned with finding/ambiguous passages (calibration half); then threshold = maximise the share of remarks captured on the calibration half subject to accepted-answer error <= 8%, >= 20 accepted answers and cancelling-negation accuracy >= 100%; variant (embedding model, scoring, L2, negation margin) = lowest error among the selectable variants whose capture under that rule is within 2 points of the best

split.stratifiedBy: language x main category (picking, off-list, ambiguous, cancelling negation, inherent negation, multi-finding, single)

clusterThresholdSelection.rule: lowest t with <= 1% of cross-language different-finding example pairs >= t
